prek_hooks.name: 🐍 claude-all · No module-level _names
prek_hooks.description: Module-level names use __all__, never a leading underscore.

prek_hooks.name: 🧪 claude-all · No setdefault of CI-reserved env vars
prek_hooks.description: Tests must not setdefault CI-reserved environment variables.

prek_hooks.name: 🗃️ claude-all · Single migration head
prek_hooks.description: One Alembic head and valid revision ids.

prek_hooks.name: 🧮 claude-all · Gate scanned= denominator
prek_hooks.description: Flags checker scripts that never print a scanned=N denominator line, so a zero-input run cannot pass silently.

prek_hooks.name: 🔌 claude-all · Checker hook registration
prek_hooks.description: Flags checker scripts that no hook entry/args in prek.toml or .pre-commit-config.yaml references, so a landed gate never stays unarmed.
